record.title: Latest MEASURE epistemic-capital state
record.body: R77 changed the portfolio observation function from bounded repository estimation to exact authority-scoped repository/default-branch/head census with 50 reusable sensors. Marketplace exact base=04cd8add33e732c556a916a8182d25f8849ec557; qualified head=d79b687ad0acc7a69b0386af7eec0c74ccbae029; merge=8ecb78504241aef4fb1de1bd4f14bd1e71089a0b; PR=313. Meaningful marketplace commits=63, all exact run-attributed by Schedule-Run trailers. One verification review found the initial collector omitted exact default-head resolution; repaired in c8a07aa2f0069c38f21b04c637543b13a3f549cf and permanently falsified by d79b687ad0acc7a69b0386af7eec0c74ccbae029. Exact R77/R76/R34 courts passed on final head. Main branch was unprotected/no required checks; broader CI was in progress and Vacuity pending at merge and was not credited as green. T over start-to-merge interval=236.50 meaningful commits/hour; G=1.0 at canonical GGEN-owned pack surface. D live=PARTIAL_ALIVE, F live=PARTIAL_ALIVE, U=UNKNOWN[NO_DOWNSTREAM_REFINEMENT_POPULATION], E=2.25 from 9 actionable classes/4 seed observations, M=0.5 provisional from 4 memory-caused opportunities/8 consumed/requested records pending individual proxy read receipts. Connector owner-repository census returned 100 repos at offset 0 and zero at offset 100; this is an authority-scoped reachable universe, not proof of the full public account population. R77 collector therefore records authenticated/public scope and refuses false totality. RevenueFROMCustomer and RevenueFORCustomer remain UNKNOWN without live economic proof. 1000X NOT_ADMITTED. Next EXPLORE handoff: execute authenticated R77 census with exact head resolution, project every repo into structural existing→desired→ontology→pack/composition→generator candidates, resolve D/F, and use rate-drop sensors to identify throughput constraints.
